name: selftest_send
sql: do $$ begin if drops_watch.send('selftest', 'selftest', E'🧪 DROPS WATCHDOG — TEST PING\n\nThe stall-alert path for the drops page is installed: pg_cron checks https://stennisfy-drops.fly.dev/health every minute and alerts this chat when the endpoint is unreachable 3 times in a row or its data is stale. No action needed.') is null then raise exception 'selftest ping not queued: %', (select delivery from drops_watch.messages where kind = 'selftest' order by id desc limit 1); end if; end $$; select 'queued' as selftest

name: selftest_delivered
sql: do $$ declare d text := (select delivery from drops_watch.messages where kind = 'selftest' order by id desc limit 1); begin if d is distinct from 'sent' then raise exception 'selftest ping not confirmed sent: %', d; end if; end $$; select 'sent' as selftest

name: messages
sql: select id, kind, condition, delivery, created_at from drops_watch.messages order by id desc limit 5

name: checks
sql: select id, fired_at, status_code, body->>'ok' ok, body->>'ageS' age_s, body->>'freshness' freshness, error from drops_watch.checks order by id desc limit 5

name: state_and_job
sql: select s.condition, s.since, j.jobname, j.schedule, j.active from drops_watch.state s, cron.job j where j.jobname = 'ten294_drops_watchdog'
